title: A Spacewalker's Suit Swelled Up and He Couldn't Get Back In

scenes.text: A cosmonaut's spacesuit swelled up, and he couldn't get back inside.
March 1965. Alexei Leonov makes the first spacewalk in history.
In the vacuum, his suit puffs out and stiffens.
Now he can't fit through the airlock.
So he opens a valve and bleeds air out of his own suit.
It's dangerous, but it works. He squeezes in after twelve minutes.
The first spacewalk almost ended in disaster.

description:
A cosmonaut's spacesuit swelled up, and he couldn't get back inside.
On the first spacewalk in 1965, Alexei Leonov's suit ballooned and stiffened in the vacuum, and he had to vent some of his air to squeeze back through the airlock.
Would you have opened that valve?
first_comment: Bonus: the whole spacewalk lasted just over twelve minutes. Would you do it?
